answer_1.quote: Lyrics generation is also a special task of NLG.

answer_2.quote: We use three kinds of objective evaluation metrics: general level, low level, and high level ... General Level: Besides perplexity (PPL), we use Integrity metric ... Low Level: We use Format F1 and Beat F1 ... High Level: ... Structure F1.

answer_4.quote: we invite 43 annotators to evaluate the generated lyrics.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator is required to score lyrics concerning four aspects. Each aspect is rated with an opinion score from 1 to 5 ... 1) Coherence ... 2) Fluency ... 3) Correlation ... 4) Fascination ...
